title: Total
qualification: Qualification  Qualifications / Essential Qualifications: B.E./B.Tech./B.Sc (Engg.) – (Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Instrumentation) or Mechanical/Welding/NDT with ASNT Level-II Certificate (in RT/ UT/ MPT /LPT) with minimum 60% or equivalent CGPI. The specified qualification should have been acquired within the prescribed minimum course duration. Experience: For Grade III – Minimum 9 years post qualification relevant experience (out of which minimum 5 years in Construction Management and Project execution in refinery/ petrochemical/ Cross Country Pipeline). For Grade IV – Minimum 13 years post qualification relevant experience (out of which minimum 5 years in Construction Management and Project execution in refinery/ petrochemical). Desirable: Experience in LNG Port, Offshore & Jetty Project site shall be an added advantage.
age_limit: EIL Recruitment 2026 Age Limit (as on 31-03-2026)  Maximum Age Limit: 41 years for Associate Engineer Grade III positions Maximum Age Limit: 45 years for Associate Engineer Grade IV positions Age relaxations: 10 years for PwD; 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (NCL), additional for PwD + category; relaxable for Ex-Servicemen as per rules.
